title: Woman walks down the street, looking worried as she sings, "Talkin’ to myself…
content:
Woman walks down the street, looking worried as she sings, "Talkin’ to myself in quiet little circles, sinkin’ in."

Front medium shot, with the camera moving backward as she walks toward it.

Use the audio from the attached video reference.

es.content:
---
Mujer camina por la calle, luciendo preocupada mientras canta: "Talkin’ to myself in quiet little circles, sinkin’ in."

Plano medio frontal, con la cámara moviéndose hacia atrás mientras ella camina hacia ella.

Usa el audio del video de referencia adjunto.
---

fr.content:
---
Une femme marche dans la rue, l'air préoccupé, en chantant : "Talkin’ to myself in quiet little circles, sinkin’ in."

Plan moyen de face, avec la caméra qui recule pendant qu'elle s'avance vers elle.

Utilisez l'audio de la référence vidéo jointe.
---

ja.content:
---
女性が通りを歩きながら心配そうな表情で歌う。「静かな小さな円の中で自分に話しかけ、沈んでいく。」

フロントのミディアムショットで、彼女がカメラに向かって歩くにつれてカメラが後退する。

添付のビデオ参照からオーディオを使用してください。
---

ko.content:
여자가 길을 걸으며 걱정스러운 표정으로 노래한다, "Talkin’ to myself in quiet little circles, sinkin’ in."

앞쪽 중간 샷, 그녀가 걸어오면서 카메라가 뒤로 움직인다.

첨부된 비디오 참고 자료의 오디오를 사용하세요.

pt.content:
Mulher anda pela rua, parecendo preocupada enquanto canta: "Talkin’ to myself in quiet little circles, sinkin’ in."

Plano médio frontal, com a câmera se movendo para trás enquanto ela caminha em direção a ela.

Use o áudio do vídeo de referência anexado.

zh.content:
---
女人走在街上，神情忧虑地唱着：“Talkin’ to myself in quiet little circles, sinkin’ in.”

前中景，随着她走向镜头，镜头向后移动。

使用附加视频参考中的音频。
